restaurantName: AOR La Table, le Goût et Nous
address: 2 rue de la Piscine, Riquewihr, 68340, France
bio: Something of a UFO in the gastronomic universe of Alsace, globetrotting cook, Serge Burckel, is also part poet, part rock star – check out the old LPs and CDs recycled as place mats! He works with his family in a bohemian, laid-back ambience, with a choice of surprise menus....
